issues.text: From the prereq I know maxUnavailable is 25% by default, but I had to guess that 25% of two Pods means zero may be missing, and that an old Pod would only go once a new one became available. The q1 explanation says the second part; the lesson body does not.
issues.quote: With two replicas, none may be missing, so neither old Pod is removed
issues.fix: Add a clause: 'With two replicas, the default 25% allows no Pod to be missing, and an old Pod goes only once a new one is available, so neither old Pod is removed.'
